# @elata-biosciences/app-state — context for tools and agents

## Role
Per-user, per-app key-value storage for apps running inside the Elata App Store's sandboxed iframe. Save games, settings, progress. No backend needed; the app never sees the user's identity. The store persists values to the user's account, so they follow the user across devices.

## API
- `getState(key) -> Promise<unknown | null>`: `null` if never set.
- `setState(key, value) -> Promise<void>`.
- `deleteState(key) -> Promise<void>`: idempotent.
- Errors: `AppStateError` with `code` in `no_parent | timeout | invalid_input` (local) or `not_authenticated | value_too_large | fetch_failed` (from the store).

## Limits
- Keys: 1-256 chars from `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / -`.
- Values: JSON-serializable, up to 64 KB encoded.
- Scope: one namespace per (user, app).

## Gotchas
- Signed-out users get `not_authenticated`. Keep a local fallback (e.g. localStorage) and sync when they sign in.
- Outside the store (localhost) calls reject with `no_parent` or time out.
- For histories of events or scores, use `@elata-biosciences/app-metrics` instead.

## Message types (wrapped by this package)
`elata:state:get|set|delete` → `elata:state:get|set|delete:result`.

## Docs
https://docs.elata.bio/apps/platform/app-state
